betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Need to know when your network has enough of something? The §6ME Level Emitter §femits a redstone signal based on item count.

Put an item in the config slot, set a threshold, and the emitter outputs signal strength 15 when the count meets your target. Flip it to §6LOW_SIGNAL §fmode and it outputs when the count drops below instead.

The real power move: add a §6Crafting Upgrade §fand the emitter will request a crafting job automatically when the count drops below threshold. Set it and forget it.

Fuzzy Mode lets you match ore-dictionary equivalents. The §6Fluid Level Emitter §fdoes the same thing for fluids.

§ePS:§f A Crafting Upgrade turns the emitter from a passive sensor into an active restocking trigger.
